title: parallel workflow: every worker's identity is its own (tool + worktree id), never the git login; task ids unique per worker
goal: Make susi workflow guarantee that each agent worktree answers to its own identity of the form <TOOL><WORKTREE-ID> and never to the shared git login (INTELLIBITZ) or to PRIMARY, and that task ids minted from it are therefore unique. who() stops falling back to git user.name; workflow check fails on a borrowed identity and self-heals when safe; tasks add/claim refuse a borrowed identity; susi-worktree.sh and workflow start name the tool, not the login.
